comparison.objective: Place setting blocks and stand a glass unit on them without sill contact; candidate performs terminal extraction.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fragile-panel handling, vertical alignment, and supported placement versus fine retention-tool insertion and controlled pullout.
comparison.success_condition: Blocks set and glass standing on both without forbidden sill touch versus intact reusable terminal and housing after removal. Candidate thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Fragile large-panel installation and support placement do not test connector depinning.
